defs.def: to say that you are annoyed, unhappy or not satisfied about sb/sth 抱怨；埋怨；投诉；发牢骚

ex.s: You can’t expect your child to tackle their tasks with enthusiasm while you’re complaining about loading the dishwasher.
ex.t: 你不能一边抱怨着把碗碟放进洗碗机，一边指望孩子满怀热情地完成自己的任务。

ex.s: Instead of simply complaining, he decided to do something about it.
ex.t: 一时间，所有人都沉默了。

ex.s: One funny observation about problem in your life can be funny, but five is just complaining, no matter how smart you think you are.
ex.t: 对你生活中的问题做一个有趣的观察可能很有趣，但五个就是抱怨了，不管你觉得自己多聪明。

ex.s: The students began complaining about how cold it would be.
ex.t: 后来他们都承认一开始确实感觉到了冷水。

ex.s: B． To stop complaining all the time．
Sometimes, the parents ___28___ complain about the role of screens in family life are just as guilty of spending too much time in front of one.
ex.t: 父母需要限制自己和尤其是孩子的屏幕时间——即使这意味着扮演坏人角色。

ex.s: In another letter, Father Christmas complained about how he could not stop his helpers playing games with the toys instead of wrappings them up.
ex.t: 在另一封信中，圣诞老人抱怨说，他无法阻止他的助手们玩玩具，而不是把玩具包起来。

ex.s: In another letter, Father Christmas complained about 8 with the toys.
ex.t: 在另一封信中，圣诞老人抱怨有8个玩具。

ex.s: I’m young and have many hidden qualities; I’m young and strong and living through a big adventure; I’m right in the middle of it and can’t spend all day complaining because it’s impossible to have any fun!
ex.t: 我年轻，有很多隐藏的品质；我年轻，坚强，经历了一场大冒险；我正处于冒险的中间，不能整天抱怨，因为不可能有任何乐趣！

ex.s: Be brave and do not complain when you experience hard times.
ex.t: 当你经历困难时，要勇敢，不要抱怨。

ex.s: Finding a good husband should be their final goal!” her brother complained, thinking of the high tuition fees.
ex.t: 找到一个好丈夫应该是他们的最终目标！ ”她哥哥抱怨说，想到高昂的学费。
